  name: x
  config:
    welcome: 1
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai'
  config:
    providers:
      llama-local:
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
        models:
        - id: fixture-model
          contextWindow: 4096

      serverName: files
      transport: stdio
      command: npx
      args:
      - -y

  name: x
  config:
    value: !!js "() => 1"
